records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww A 29 year old patient, with a known ovarian cyst presents to ED complaining of worsening pelvic pain and pain in the medial thigh region. Irritation of which of the following structures is responsible for the pain in the medial thigh region:
records.explanation: The obturator nerve runs lateral to the ovaries in the ovarian fossa and irritation of the obturator nerve from ovarian pathology can result in referred pain to the medial thigh. Vv Ovary ANATOMY / ABDOMEN / FEMALE REPRODUCTIVE SYSTEM

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww Which of the following areas of the prostate gland is most commonly involved in carcinomatous transformation:
records.explanation: The peripheral zone is the outermost region of the prostate and the area most prone to carcinomatous transformation. This is the zone palpated on PR examination. ° - : Vv Prostate ANATOMY / ABDOMEN / MALE REPRODUCTIVE SYSTEM 11 Ranemark

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww Which of the following is NOT an anatomical feature that prevents against gastric reflux:
options: The diaphragmatic pinchcock effect on the oesophagus 4%
Intra-abdominal pressure which maintains the oesophagus in a state of collapse when empty 15%
The angle of His formed at the junction of the oesophagus and gastric fundus 6%
Gastric mucosal rosette-like folds at the gastro-oesophageal junction 10%
The striated lower oesophageal sphincter muscle
records.explanation: The lower oesophageal sphincter is not a distinct muscular structure composed of skeletal muscle like the upper oesophageal sphincter. The lower oesophageal sphincter is formed from a high-pressure zone of smooth muscle, located at the gastro-oesophageal junction. Vv Oesophagus (Abdominal) ANATOMY / ABDOMEN / GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: A70 year old undergoes radical prostatectomy for prostate cancer. Postoperatively he complains of urinary incontinence due to paralysis of the external urethral sphincter. Which of the following nerves was most likely injured during surgery:
records.explanation: The voluntary external urethral sphincter is innervated by the pudendal nerve (S2 - S4). Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: The iliohypogastric nerve is formed from the anterior rami of:
records.explanation: The iliohypogastric nerve is formed from the anterior rami of L1. It innervates the internal oblique and the transversus abdominis muscles and supplies posterolateral gluteal skin and skin over the pubic region. . Vv
warnings: No marked correct option was detected.

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: Which of the following best describes the regions of the abdomen that the liver normally occupies:
options: Right hypochondrium, epigastric region and left hypochondrium
records.explanation: The liver is the largest visceral organ in the body and is primarily located in the right hypochondrium and epigastric region, extending into the left hypochondrium. < ? Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww A patient with known inflammatory bowel disease presents to ED complaining of severe abdominal pain and diarrhoea. Imaging shows a flare up primarily affecting the rectum. Which of the following nerves is most likely responsible for transmission of pain from the rectum:
records.explanation: The visceral afferent innervation of the rectum is transmitted by way of the pelvic splanchnic nerves, which also provide parasympathetic supply. Sympathetic nervous supply to the rectum is from the lumbar splanchnic nerves (L1, L2) and the inferior mesenteric plexus (upper rectum) and hypogastric plexuses (middle and lower rectum). v

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww A19 year old male is brought to ED having sustained a handlebar injury with blunt trauma to his upper abdomen whilst riding his scooter. Which of the following is the most commonly injured organ:
records.explanation: The liver and spleen are the most commonly injured organs with this clinical picture. / v

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: w Which of the following lies immediately medial to the second part of the duodenum:
records.explanation: The descending (second) part is just to the right of the midline, extending from the neck of the gallbladder to the lower border of vertebra L3 and lying lateral to the head of the pancreas. This part contains the major duodenal papilla which is the common entrance for the bile and pancreatic ducts. ; ? Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: A 64 year old man with known liver cirrhosis secondary to chronic alcohol abuse presents to ED vomiting profuse bright red blood. Endoscopy demonstrates ruptured oesophageal varices. Which of the following veins forms a portosystemic anastomosis with caval veins to form the varices:
records.explanation: The left gastric vein and its tributaries from a portosystemic anastomosis with tributaries to the azygos system of veins of the caval system at the gastroesophageal junction around the cardia of the stomach. : Vv
